signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to manage your invoices.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Start financing your invoices in minutes.
signUp.acceptTerms: I accept the Terms and the Privacy Policy.

recover.title: Recover your password
recover.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to create a new one.

recoverSent.title: Check your email
recoverSent.body: If an account exists for {{email}}, a link will arrive in a few minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: This is the password you will sign in with from now on.
reset.missingTokenBody: The code that identifies it is missing. It may have been cut off when copied; ask for a new one and try again.

errors.email-already-in-use: An account with this email already exists.
errors.role-not-allowed: We could not create your account with that profile type.
errors.validation-failed: Check the details: something is not right.
errors.invalid-request: Check the details: something is not right.
errors.user-not-found: We could not find an account with that email.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to do this.
errors.unreachable: We could not reach Vankoo. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.signUpFailed: We could not create your account. Please try again.
errors.invalid-password-reset-token: That link no longer works: it may have expired or already been used. Ask for a new one.

upload.title: Upload invoice

dropzone.cta: Drag a file here or click to choose one

upload.helper: PDF of an electronic invoice issued through SUNAT. We extract the data: you do not have to type anything.
upload.afterTitle: What happens after you upload it
upload.afterBody: We read the data, check that it adds up, and validate the invoice with SUNAT. If everything checks out, we publish it so investors can fund it.

empty.title: You do not have any invoices yet
empty.description: Upload your first invoice and our system will extract the data automatically.

detail.loadFailed: We could not load this invoice. It may not exist, or there may be a connection problem.
detail.subtitle: {{payer}} · due {{date}}

reviewAlert.title: We need you to review this invoice
reviewAlert.fallbackMessage: There is something to fix before this can continue.

notEligibleAlert.title: We cannot fund this invoice
notEligibleAlert.fallbackMessage: This invoice does not qualify for funding.

received.automatic: Step 1 of 5 · we recorded that the invoice arrived.

reading.automatic: Step 2 of 5 · we are reading the invoice's data. This is automatic.
reading.attention: Stopped at step 2 of 5 · this does not move on its own: someone has to fix it.

validating.automatic: Step 3 of 5 · checking with SUNAT that the invoice is legitimate. This is automatic.
validating.attention: Stopped at step 3 of 5 · this does not move on its own: someone has to fix it.
validating.blocked: Dead end · the invoice is readable and its numbers add up, but it is not eligible for funding.

approved.automatic: Step 4 of 5 · the invoice was approved and is ready to go to auction.
approved.attention: Step 4 of 5 · review the offer and accept it to publish the invoice.

inAuction.automatic: Step 5 of 5 · the invoice is published in the auction.
inAuction.attention: Stopped at step 5 of 5 · this does not move on its own: someone has to fix it.

facts.title: Data we read from the invoice

settlement.pendingFootnote: You will know how much you receive once the invoice is approved and goes to auction: the discount and the fee are set there.

errors.uploadFailed: We could not upload the invoice. Please try again.
errors.notVerified: Your company must be verified to upload invoices.

kycGate.title: Your company is not verified yet
kycGate.message: You can upload invoices once we verify your company.

home.title: Signed in
home.placeholder: Placeholder screen. The MYPE dashboard arrives once invoices, profile and wallet are designed.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.body: The link may be misspelled, or the page may have moved.

dialog.title: Accept the offer and publish the invoice?
dialog.body: You will receive {{amount}} in your wallet once the auction is funded. Accepting publishes the invoice to the investors, and it cannot be withdrawn from here.

errors.quoteNotActive: This offer is no longer valid. Here is the current one.
errors.tooCloseToDueDate: The invoice is due too soon to open an auction.
errors.unknown: We could not complete the operation. Please try again.

reasons.PAYER_NOT_IN_REGISTRY: The payer's RUC is not in SUNAT's registry. Check that it is written correctly on the invoice.
reasons.PAYER_NOT_ACTIVE: The payer is not an active taxpayer according to SUNAT, so we cannot fund invoices in its name.
reasons.PAYER_DOMICILE_NOT_FOUND: SUNAT cannot locate the payer's fiscal address, so we cannot fund invoices in its name.
reasons.PAYER_SHELL_COMPANY: SUNAT has declared the payer a taxpayer without operating capacity: it does not consider its operations real, so we cannot fund invoices in its name.

certificate.title: Green certificate
certificate.intro: Upload your environmental certificate (ISO 14001 or ISO 50001) and your invoices can carry the Green Factoring badge in the marketplace.
certificate.notGreenBody: We could not validate it. See what failed and upload another certificate.
certificate.reviewing: We are reading your certificate. It usually takes a few seconds.
certificate.disclaimer: We check that the certificate is in force and matches your company in SUNAT, and that you have no OEFA sanctions. We do not verify its authenticity with the certification body.
certificate.needsVerification: You can upload it once we verify your company.

errors.load: We could not load your profile. Try again in a moment.
errors.save: We could not send your data. Check the ficha RUC and try again.
errors.upload: We could not upload the certificate. Use a PDF, JPG or PNG and try again.
errors.contact: We could not save your contact details. Try again.
errors.logo: We could not upload the logo. Use a JPG or PNG image.

onboarding.title: Complete your company profile
onboarding.subtitle: We verify your RUC before you can operate. It is done only once.
onboarding.rucDocumentHelp: It is the certified report you download from SUNAT Operaciones en Línea with your Clave SOL. It carries a digital signature and a QR code.

dropzone.title: Drag the file here or click to choose it
dropzone.hint: Your ficha RUC's PDF, exactly as you download it from SUNAT

onboarding.rucDocumentNotPdf: The ficha RUC must be the PDF you download from SUNAT.
onboarding.rucNotFound: We could not find that RUC. Check the number.
onboarding.nameMismatch: It does not match the business name SUNAT has for your RUC.

review.title: We are reviewing your profile
review.subtitle: We check your RUC against SUNAT's register and review the ficha you sent.
review.alertTitle: You can come in, but not operate yet
review.alertMessage: You will be able to upload invoices and top up your wallet once we verify your company.

rejected.title: We could not verify your company
rejected.subtitle: Check what we found and send it again. You keep what you already typed.
rejected.retryAt: You can send it again on {{date}}.
rejected.retryNow: You can send it again now.

TAXPAYER_FOUND.title: We could not find your RUC at SUNAT
TAXPAYER_FOUND.message: Check the number and send it again.

RUC_DOCUMENT_SIGNED.title: The ficha RUC does not carry SUNAT's digital signature
RUC_DOCUMENT_SIGNED.message: Download it again from SUNAT Operaciones en Línea and upload it as it is, without editing or scanning it.

RUC_DOCUMENT_RECENT.title: The ficha RUC is more than 30 days old
RUC_DOCUMENT_RECENT.message: Download a new one from SUNAT Operaciones en Línea.

RUC_DOCUMENT_MATCHES.title: The ficha RUC belongs to another RUC
RUC_DOCUMENT_MATCHES.message: Upload the ficha of the RUC you typed.

NAME_MATCHES.title: The business name does not match SUNAT's
NAME_MATCHES.message: Type it exactly as it appears on your ficha RUC.

TAXPAYER_ACTIVE.title: Your RUC is not active at SUNAT
TAXPAYER_ACTIVE.message: We can only verify taxpayers whose status is ACTIVO.

DOMICILE_FOUND.title: Your tax address is not listed as found (habido)
DOMICILE_FOUND.message: Regularize your tax address at SUNAT and send it again.

NOT_SHELL_COMPANY.title: Your RUC is on SUNAT's SSCO list
NOT_SHELL_COMPANY.message: SUNAT lists it as having no operating capacity, so we cannot verify it.

UNKNOWN.title: We could not verify your company
UNKNOWN.message: Check your data and your ficha RUC and send them again.

kyc.title: Verification
kyc.notSubmitted: You have not sent your data yet.
kyc.demoNote: Demonstration ficha signed by Vankoo, not by SUNAT.

reviewBanner.title: We are reviewing your data
reviewBanner.message: You can move around the app, but you cannot edit your profile or operate until we finish.

edit.title: Edit contact details
edit.description: The RUC and the business name do not change: they are what we verified with SUNAT.
